title: National Partnership Emails — 2015
notes: This archive explicitly labels named men as 'Partnership men' serving on RPR, the Nominating Committee, the Overtures Committee, and other Committees of Commissioners.
The correspondence states that participation in NP entails helping fill denominational committee positions and describes the Overtures Committee as a principal point of influence.
Committee-placement labels are treated as direct membership evidence. Overture positions or messages forwarded to the list are separate evidence classes.

The archive also contains internal discussion of racial-reconciliation proposals; those issue positions are not automatically treated as membership evidence for people merely mentioned in the discussion.
